FILE probe03/job.sbatch bytes=2445 sha256=27fc569e347943973077d4acb64e1086533923b9474b4b2e543cae5f3daf2700
#!/usr/bin/env bash
#SBATCH --job-name=SIO174-ABI01
#SBATCH --partition=cpu-ops
#SBATCH --nodelist=cpuops-t560-proxmox
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=1
#SBATCH --mem=4096M
#SBATCH --time=00:10:00
#SBATCH --export=NIL
set -uo pipefail
export PATH=/usr/bin:/bin LANG=C LC_ALL=C
ulimit -s 524288
ulimit -c 0
p=/scratch/sounio-stdlib-inference-scale-20261024/SIO174/probe03
cd "$p/source";export SOUNIO_STDLIB_PATH="$PWD/stdlib";out="$p/artifacts"
export MADAROS_RAW_BIN=/scratch/sounio-stdlib-inference-scale-20261024/compiler_ci_c21/madaros.elf.ready
export SOUC_NATIVE_BIN=/scratch/sounio-stdlib-inference-scale-20261024/SIO166/source14/bin/souc-lean-single-x86_64
export SOUNIO_MADAROS_NOCACHE=1 SOUNIO_MADAROS_CACHE_READONLY=1
src=docs/evidence/stdlib-SIO-174/probe03/adjacent.sio
find docs -type f -print0|sort -z|xargs -0 sha256sum > "$out/SOURCE.sha256";sha256sum "$MADAROS_RAW_BIN" "$SOUC_NATIVE_BIN">"$out/COMPILERS.sha256"
for engine in madaros seed;do
 rc=0
 if [[ $engine == madaros ]];then timeout 180 bin/souc check "$src">"$out/$engine.check.stdout" 2>"$out/$engine.check.stderr"||rc=$?;else timeout 180 bash scripts/ci/souc-native-wrapper.sh check "$src">"$out/$engine.check.stdout" 2>"$out/$engine.check.stderr"||rc=$?;fi
 echo "$rc">"$out/$engine.check.status"
 if [[ $rc != 0 ]];then continue;fi
 rc=0
 if [[ $engine == madaros ]];then timeout 240 bin/souc compile "$src" -o "$out/$engine.elf">"$out/$engine.compile.stdout" 2>"$out/$engine.compile.stderr"||rc=$?;else timeout 240 "$SOUC_NATIVE_BIN" "$src" "$out/$engine.elf">"$out/$engine.compile.stdout" 2>"$out/$engine.compile.stderr"||rc=$?;fi
 echo "$rc">"$out/$engine.compile.status"
 if [[ $rc == 0 && -s $out/$engine.elf ]];then chmod +x "$out/$engine.elf";timeout 60 "$out/$engine.elf">"$out/$engine.native.stdout" 2>"$out/$engine.native.stderr";echo "$?">"$out/$engine.native.status";sha256sum "$out/$engine.elf">"$out/$engine.ELF.sha256";fi
done
sha256sum -c "$out/SOURCE.sha256">"$out/SOURCE.verify.txt";sha256sum -c "$out/COMPILERS.sha256">"$out/COMPILERS.verify.txt"
rc=0;g++ -std=c++23 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror docs/evidence/stdlib-SIO-174/probe03/reference.cpp -o "$out/reference">"$out/cpp.stdout" 2>"$out/cpp.stderr"||rc=$?;echo "$rc">"$out/cpp.status"
if [[ $rc == 0 ]];then for engine in madaros seed;do "$out/reference" "$out/$engine.native.stdout">"$out/$engine.reference.stdout" 2>"$out/$engine.reference.stderr";echo "$?">"$out/$engine.reference.status";done;fi

END_FILE
